name: Olympic National Park
description: Olympic National Park fills much of Washington State's Olympic Peninsula, packing glacier-topped peaks, wildflower meadows, mossy temperate rainforest and 100 km of wild Pacific coastline into a single park. The coast is the longest undeveloped stretch in the contiguous United States. Eleven rivers run down from the mountains, and the old-growth forests shelter rare spotted owls and marbled murrelets.
